# MediaTek
> MediaTek designs and delivers semiconductor platforms and chipsets for mobile, smart home, automotive, connectivity, IoT, and edge AI devices.

MediaTek’s website combines product information, industry solutions, technology overviews, corporate resources, investor materials, newsroom updates, and support content for developers, partners, and customers.

## Products
- [Mobile Phone Chipsets](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smartphones): Smartphone SoCs and mobile platforms across flagship, premium, and mainstream device tiers.
- [Tablet Chipsets](https://www.mediatek.com/products/tablets): Application processors and connectivity solutions for Android tablets and large-screen mobile devices.
- [Chromebook Chipsets](https://www.mediatek.com/products/chromebooks): Compute platforms optimized for Chromebooks with performance, efficiency, and integrated connectivity.
- [Smart Home](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smart-home): Chipsets for smart TVs, voice assistants, displays, and connected home entertainment devices.
- [Wi-Fi](https://www.mediatek.com/products/wi-fi): Wireless connectivity solutions spanning consumer, broadband, and device-side Wi-Fi technologies.
- [Broadband](https://www.mediatek.com/products/broadband): Access and networking silicon for gateways, routers, fiber, and broadband infrastructure.
- [IoT](https://www.mediatek.com/products/iot): Low-power and connected platforms for embedded, industrial, and consumer IoT applications.
- [Automotive](https://www.mediatek.com/products/automotive): Automotive platforms for infotainment, connectivity, telematics, and in-vehicle digital experiences.

## Mobile Platforms
- [Dimensity](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smartphones/dimensity-5g): 5G mobile platform family for flagship and premium smartphones.
- [Helio](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smartphones/helio): 4G smartphone chipset family focused on balanced performance and efficiency.
- [Kompanio](https://www.mediatek.com/products/chromebooks/mediatek-kompanio): Compute platform family for Chromebooks and mobile computing devices.
- [Filogic](https://www.mediatek.com/products/wi-fi/mediatek-filogic): Wi-Fi platform family for routers, gateways, access points, and connected devices.
- [Pentonic](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smart-home/mediatek-pentonic): Smart TV platform family for premium displays, streaming, and AI-enhanced entertainment.
- [Genio](https://www.mediatek.com/products/iot/mediatek-genio): Edge AI and IoT platform family for embedded and industrial designs.
- [Dimensity Auto](https://www.mediatek.com/products/automotive/dimensity-auto): Automotive platform portfolio for cockpit, connectivity, and intelligent vehicle systems.

## Technology
- [5G](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/5g): MediaTek’s 5G modem, connectivity, and platform technology overview.
- [AI](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/ai): Artificial intelligence capabilities across mobile, edge, imaging, and device experiences.
- [Connectivity](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/connectivity): Wireless and wired connectivity technologies including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and broadband.
- [Imaging](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/imaging): Camera, ISP, HDR, and computational photography technologies for devices.
- [Multimedia](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/multimedia): Audio, video, display, and media processing technologies across product categories.
- [Power Efficiency](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/power-efficiency): Efficiency-focused design approaches for longer battery life and lower power consumption.
- [Gaming](https://www.mediatek.com/technology/gaming): Gaming-focused enhancements for graphics, responsiveness, and mobile gameplay experiences.

## Industries and Solutions
- [Smartphones](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smartphones): Mobile platforms for 4G and 5G smartphones across market segments.
- [Smart Home](https://www.mediatek.com/products/smart-home): Silicon solutions for TVs, displays, voice assistants, and connected home devices.
- [Automotive](https://www.mediatek.com/products/automotive): Vehicle platforms for infotainment, telematics, and connected automotive systems.
- [Broadband](https://www.mediatek.com/products/broadband): Networking and access solutions for service providers and home connectivity.
- [Wi-Fi 7](https://www.mediatek.com/products/wi-fi): Next-generation wireless connectivity platforms for routers, gateways, and client devices.
- [Edge AI IoT](https://www.mediatek.com/products/iot): Embedded and industrial IoT solutions with AI acceleration and connectivity.
- [Chromebooks](https://www.mediatek.com/products/chromebooks): Efficient compute platforms for education, productivity, and cloud-centric laptops.
